Implementation evidence

Three roles. Traceable contributions.

The business policy runs the demo. The UX skill shaped the interface. The quality procedure checks the workflow and page requirements. No live banking MCP or production AI service is connected.

Skill / roleInput and interactionOutput and resulting change
Decision Policy v1
Business-solution policy skill		Source decks: approve / verify / block + digital recovery. Example: $800, network risk 25, unfamiliar merchant, recognized device.Risk 55 → verify. Customer confirmation resolves to approval or block. This reusable executable policy materially determines the useful result.
Sites Building
UX / design skill		Five-page brief, banking customer audience, complete input-to-result workflow.Guidance: expose the activity immediately; use readable type, responsive layouts, shared navigation and explicit result states. Implemented a two-panel demo, labeled controls and polite live result announcements.
Workflow QA v1
Testing / quality procedure skill		Routine, unusual and high-risk inputs; both verification choices; wallet unavailable; malformed input; five-page navigation and video duration.Automated checks exercise all decision branches, reject invalid input, check every cross-page link and inspect video metadata. Run the decision checks below for repeatable evidence.

Repeat the decision checks

These checks call the same policy and recovery functions as the demo, including threshold boundaries and invalid-input cases.

Ready to run. Build-time results appear below.

Build-time verification: 18/18 decision checks passed; exactly 5 pages; both navigation menus link to all pages; local assets present; advertisement duration 20.0 seconds. Browser layout and native WebMCP execution were not tested.

Evidence: business policy input → output
Routine: amount 45, risk 10, familiar merchant + device → score 10 → APPROVE
Unusual: amount 800, risk 25, unfamiliar merchant → score 55 → VERIFY
Suspicious: amount 1200, risk 60, unfamiliar merchant + device → score 100 → BLOCK
Verification: yes → APPROVE; no → BLOCK
Recovery: supported wallet → simulated activation; unsupported → assisted recovery
Scope and tool availability

The business and QA skills are project-level documented procedures backed by executable JavaScript. They are not installed ChatGPT plugins. The Sites Building skill was read and applied during authoring. A browser WebMCP tool is registered only where document.modelContext is supported; the website works without it. Live browser WebMCP validation was unavailable in this build environment.

Automated checks do not establish production fraud accuracy, regulatory compliance, or actual bank savings. No customer or bank data was used.

Source trail

CEO Executive Upgrade: slides 1–3 and 6 provide planning economics; slides 4–5 provide alternatives and decision flow; slides 7–9 provide controls and assumptions. Customer Slides: slides 1–6 provide the benefit headline, customer pain points, confirmation and recovery story.

Industry figures in the decks are contextual evidence, not proof of prototype effectiveness. The 2017 Fiserv proxy is dated, and Mastercard performance is vendor-reported. Neither is used to set these demonstration thresholds.
